direct_prior.name: ALoRA
direct_prior.scope: Independent A factors with a shared B are direct prior art; the PAS A-energy router is a different routing choice, not a novelty certificate.

scope: Final text-only interpretation review of the named document; no new literature search, source inspection, numerical analysis, model, QA, tensor loading or scoring.
Accept the decision not to present shared B or shared B plus PAS energy routing as a new compact main framework, and not to implement or activate the present candidate.
Retain the narrower necessity question of whether a second B is worth preserving; prior art does not prohibit that research question.
findings: Sharing B does not by itself force equal A-energy scores or uniform routing, and unequal scores do not establish useful response differences.
The incremental coefficient count changes from 2*r*(n+m) to 2*r*n+r*m; this does not remove any W0 coefficients or establish a reduction of the complete base model.
A zero B gives the common parent output in exact arithmetic, while shared-gradient accumulation and optimizer state differ from two independently trained B factors.
Any future minimal binding comparison must disclose coordinate and optimization differences and define shared-parameter historical-importance accounting before implementation.
Missing native starting quality is not a score-based admission gate and the prior preprocessing failure is not evidence of poor carrier quality.
limits: The cited prior-art interpretation is consumed from this bounded discussion; no independent network re-verification was performed in this final review.
No empirical evidence of quality retention, expert specialization, historical protection, parameter avoidability or complete-model compression is accepted.
The shared-output-space restriction is a representation boundary, not a finite-budget learning or Answer F1 conclusion.
No old failed or completed branch is reopened, and no CPU gate, source implementation, model activation, rank/LR search or automatic follow-up experiment is authorized.
